zh.description: 我是一名具有 4年+ 工作经验的 AI应用工程师，擅长使用 Cursor、OpenClaw 等主流 AI 编程工具，将 AI 能力融入软件开发全过程，实现需求调研、开发、部署、文档编写一体化工作流程。

en.description: I am an AI Application Engineer with 4+ years of experience, proficient in using mainstream AI coding tools like Cursor and OpenClaw.

zh.description: 我坚信 兴趣是最好的老师。从大学接触编程开始，就对软件开发产生了浓厚的兴趣。正是这份热爱驱使我不断学习新技术，探索 AI 辅助开发的无限可能。

en.description: I believe interest is the best teacher. Since starting programming in university, I have been deeply interested in software development.

zh.description: 我坚信 AI 是新时代开发者的必备技能。善于利用 AI 工具提升开发效率，缩短项目周期，降低沟通成本。同时具备扎实的 Java 技术功底，精通 SpringBoot、SpringCloud 等主流框架。

en.description: I believe AI is an essential skill for developers in the new era. Good at using AI tools to improve development efficiency.

zh.description: 工作之外，我是资深的独立游戏爱好者，热爱折腾各类游戏 Mod 开发。我享受在代码世界中创造乐趣的过程，这也让我对编程保持持续的热情。

en.description: Outside of work, I am an avid indie game enthusiast who loves creating game mods. This keeps my passion for programming alive.

zh.description: 期待与您合作，共同探索 AI 赋能软件开发的可能性！

en.description: Looking forward to collaborating with you to explore AI-powered software development!
